question: Can H-387 neutral recorder printing-density aims be consumed by the existing generic density-to-print interpretation through a separate typed neutral anchor, without relabeling them as developed camera-film density, Status M, stock colour or scanner calibration?

adapter.neutral_replication: raw printing density repeated exactly on RGB only after raw density is finite and nonnegative
adapter.code_sweep_domain: For each mode, derive the maximal contiguous code subset whose repeated neutral raw printing density lies inside every declared print-interpretation reference channel; codes outside that subset must reject without clamping.

allowed_after_pass: retain a research-only typed neutral recorder/print anchor adapter
use H-387 aims as neutral recorder-control priors in a separately frozen print-chain audit
compare neutral recorder controls with generic print interpretation without stock colour claims
forbidden: treat recorder printing density as camera-film developed density
treat printing density as Status M or add D-min twice
consume the clamped physical zero for negative raw interpositive tail codes
derive RGB colour response from neutral LAD aims
claim local recorder, print stock, process or scanner calibration
photographic fitting, visual promotion or product integration

branch_rule.pass: Retain the isolated neutral compatibility adapter and open only a separately frozen neutral recorder/print-chain synthetic audit.
branch_rule.fail: Keep P6R as a standalone typed primitive and do not force it through existing interpretation types.

claim_ceiling: Exact neutral-axis interoperability between manufacturer-documented recorder printing density and one existing generic print interpretation; not camera-film density, RGB stock response, local calibration, scanner profile, photographic quality or product promotion.
